parsed.rationale: Both participating records carry `is_test: true` and reside in `Shared/Playlist/Tests/PlaylistTests/PlaylistFetcherTests.swift`. Although the two test methods `fetchPlaylistReturnsEmptyOnURLError` (line 65) and `fetchPlaylistReturnsEmptyOnDecodingError` (line 84) share a high structural similarity (Jaccard 0.857), they are intentional test fixtures that each verify a distinct error path — URL errors versus decoding errors — and their near-duplication is a deliberate consequence of the arrange-act-assert pattern common in unit tests. Merging or abstracting them risks obscuring the specific failure scenario each test is designed to surface, reducing diagnostic clarity when a test fails.
